name: It looks like they just do catering now.
description: It looks like they just do catering now. is a working pumpkin patch in Livermore, ME. It grows Strawberries, Raspberries, Apples, Peaches, and Cherries, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
